summary: Bitdeer Technologies Group filed a Form 6-K (US equivalent of an 8-K furnishing a press release) dated September 16, 2026, attaching its routine August 2026 production and operations update. No special situation is present: the filing covers monthly bitcoin production, AI cloud GPU deployment and utilization, and ordinary commercial contracting — including a 16-year Tydal, Norway AI/HPC lease with roughly $4.7 billion initial contract value and a 200-acre Rockdale land acquisition for AI/HPC development. The registrant is the issuer/filer, not an acquirer of a public target. No deal terms, premium, or board recommendation are stated.
